materialChangeSummary: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT NOTICE. An announced successor with a future effective date, used only to exercise the "announced change" display and the gate repeating after activation.
reviewEvidence: None. Synthetic development content; not reviewed and not for publication (tasks.md T030, gated on T041-T043).

sections.heading: About this notice
paragraphs: This is a synthetic development notice. It is not a reviewed privacy notice and must not be published. It exists so the notice, account privacy and gate screens can be built and tested.
The reviewed notice will replace this text before the privacy features are switched on in production.
This synthetic successor differs from the first version only in this sentence.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Controller identity: to be supplied and reviewed (tasks.md T043).

sections.heading: What you put in
paragraphs: Required to have an account: a username and a password. The password is stored only as a one-way hash. Without them the service cannot keep a notebook for you.
Your notebook: exercises, workouts, sets, and optionally bodyweight, titles, locations and notes. Optional fields can be left empty. Notes may contain sensitive details, so choose what you write.

sections.heading: What the service does with it
paragraphs: Keeps your training log and draws progress charts from the sets you record. No automated decision-making or profiling takes place.
Purposes and lawful bases: to be recorded in the reviewed processing decision (tasks.md T041).

sections.heading: Who handles it
paragraphs: Service providers, processing locations and any transfer safeguards: to be supplied from the reviewed supplier inventory.

sections.heading: Keeping and removing it
paragraphs: You can export your notebook or delete your account. Retention periods for backups and security logs: to be supplied from the reviewed retention rules.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and portability where applicable: instructions to be supplied and reviewed.
Reading this notice, or pressing Continue, is not consent.

sections.heading: Contact and complaints
paragraphs: Privacy contact and supervisory authority: to be supplied and reviewed (tasks.md T043).
